request.title: Keep planning and statistics native date fields readable at enlarged text
request.description: The current canonical-destination browser check reproduces clipped selected-date segments in Planning at phone width with 200-percent text. The date stays valid while the year runs under the native calendar affordance.

request.priority_reason: Required native-content acceptance blocks the active canonical-destination task; the earlier completed native-date task changed Today only.
